title: Ask HN: What are tools you have made for yourself since the advent of AI?
summary: A Hacker News community discussion where users share AI-powered tools they've built for personal use, including automation scripts, code generation utilities, documentation tools, and productivity enhancers. The conversation showcases practical, real-world AI applications beyond commercial products.
problem_solved: Automating repetitive personal tasks and enhancing individual productivity through custom AI-powered solutions
why_valuable: Demonstrates practical AI applications for everyday work and highlights the democratization of tool-building through AI
